newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile, Argentina agree beef labeling rules.
newsitem.headline: Chile, Argentina agree beef labeling rules.

text.p: Chilean and Argentine agriculture authorities signed an agreement on beef labelling on Monday, defusing a brewing trade spat between the two Mercosur partners over beef imports, said a top Chilean official.

"The agreement sets out the conditions for official certificates for this type of product and fixes criteria for the supervision of Chilean rules over this issue," said Antonio Yaksic, director of the Agriculture and Livestock Service (SAG).

Chile's Supreme Court upheld last month complaints by local producers that their lower-cost Argentine counterparts were sending inferior meet over the Andes and intentionally mislabelling it as top-quality beef to undercut them.
The court ordered the SAG to ensure that labelling procedures on meat imported from Argentina are brought into line with Chile's own system.
